title: PFPD Preflight Data-Readiness & Model Preservation Audit

local_smoke_extract_test_subset.pothole_sample_skew_explanation: The smoke test extract only contained 29 readable potholes. The model detected all 29 (29/29 TP), producing an artificial 100% recall on that tiny sample. On the full 1,450-image Kaggle test population with 1,847 potholes, true pothole recall is 70.22%.

test_population_reconciliation.missing_images_location: Reside in remote Kaggle production session storage; not included in lightweight smoke artifact download.

preflight_gate.reason: In strict compliance with Stage 1 instructions, the proposed 1,500 curated images were defined as target design specifications and are NOT yet downloaded, verified, or packaged on local disk. Automated fabrication of pseudo-labels is strictly prohibited. The GPU training run is held until the data-readiness report is reviewed and explicit approval is provided.
required_next_actions: 1. Confirm candidate open datasets on Kaggle for fallen trees and boulders.
2. Download candidate subsets and execute exact MD5 & perceptual dHash cross-deduplication against the 150 benchmark images and test set.
3. Manually verify bounding box annotations for fallen trees, boulders, and signs.
4. Sample 500 replay images from the original 21,676 dataset (potholes, construction, crashes) to prevent catastrophic forgetting.
5. Recover the 366 remaining test images from Kaggle to restore the complete 1,450-image test set.
6. Present audited data manifest for final sign-off before launching the 8-epoch GPU run.
